description: Nicolaas Witsenstraat 7-19 (1873-91 by BAG, one facade design): 6.1-6.4 m fronts of a raised ground storey and three tall upper storeys of dark brown brick; three axes of white flat-headed windows with a small white block over each head and white sills; a heavy white cornice at 14.0-15.4 m; a black slate mansard with a white box dormer over the middle axis; stone balustrade balconies on brackets on some middle axes

match.note: Nicolaas Witsenstraat 7-19 on the 2024-12-04 strip: windows 1.0-3.5, 4.5-6.75, 7.9-10.0, 11.1-13.25 m; cornice 14.0-15.4 m; slate to 17.3 m; 3DBAG 5 bouwlagen, eaves 17.6-18.1 m (mansard)

mansard-box-dormer.note: a white flat-topped dormer with pilasters about 1.7 m wide over the middle axis, 15.6-17.8 m, on the black slate mansard

door-left.note: house door on the left axis

roof.evidence: Nicolaas Witsenstraat 7-19: the black slate mansard 15.4-17.3 m behind the white cornice, dormers to 17.8 m

rhythm.roofline: heavy white cornice, black slate mansard, one box dormer
